summary: Frontend-only regression test of SKIN.MRKT tile overhaul + admin login. All 5 flows validated on https://live-market-feed-4.preview.emergentagent.com. Admin login with Bituop/Bituop123 works, redirects to /admin, and all 4 tabs (Dashboard/Transactions/Users/Backup) render. Tile redesign confirmed: rounded-xl corners, rarity-text-<rarity> class applied to name, no old 'Consumer Grade/Covert' chip, no 'Seller:' line, [FT] wear bracket chip visible, price on its own line, full-width Buy button on its own line, inspect icon-only button present in top-right with opacity 1 on hover (data-testid=inspect-<id>). Search input is w-64 (256px) and sort dropdown is on the same horizontal row. Filters work (rarity=covert→0, wear=Field-Tested→1 on the single sample listing). Only one listing exists in live data, and it has no stickers/inspect_link, so the sticker-popup flow could NOT be exercised end-to-end via UI; however code review of SkinCard.jsx confirms StickerPopup renders with data-testid=sticker-popup, sticker-popup-close, and the 'Detailed sticker analytics coming soon' message, and sticker chips render as data-testid=sticker-<i> buttons opening the modal.

integration_issues.issue: toast.error('Sign in with Steam first') is fired but immediately followed by loginWithSteam() which navigates the tab to steamcommunity.com/openid — the toast is unmounted before the user can read it. Consider delaying the redirect ~1.2s (setTimeout) or letting the user click a CTA inside the toast. No crash; behavior is functional.

action_items: OPTIONAL: For better UX, delay Steam redirect in LiveListingsPage.buy() by ~1s so the 'Sign in with Steam first' toast is visible before navigation.

OPTIONAL: Seed at least one listing with stickers[] + inspect_link so future UI tests can exercise the sticker-popup + inspect-icon click paths end-to-end (currently only 1 live listing with neither).
critical_code_review_comments: SkinCard.jsx cleanName strips wear parens but the underlying wear is still surfaced via the [FT]/[MW] chip — good separation of concerns.

inspectHref replaces %listingid% with '0' unconditionally; if the actual Steam listing_id is available on the model, use it — otherwise the inspect link may 404 for market-listed items. For sold/owned inventory the current '0' fallback is fine.
StickerPopup fixed-position overlay uses z-50 and backdrop click to close — good. Consider adding an Escape key handler for a11y.
LiveListingsPage.load() dependency array includes q which triggers a request on every keystroke — consider debouncing (300ms) to reduce backend load.
AdminLoginPage lowercases input on backend side; state variable name 'email' is misleading now that plain usernames are accepted — rename to 'identifier' for clarity (cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: None. Recommend seeding a listing with stickers + inspect_link for future UI regression coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only 1 live listing (PP-Bizon | Urban Dashed, Consumer, FT, $12) exists on the preview env, and it has no stickers/inspect_link. Sticker popup and inspect icon click flows were verified structurally (element present, opacity=1 on hover) but not end-to-end. To exercise the sticker-popup UX in a browser, POST /api/listings with a payload that includes stickers:['Sticker | Titan (Holo) | Katowice 2014',...] and an inspect_link containing %owner_steamid%/%assetid%/%listingid% tokens. Admin auth token via /api/admin/login with {email:'Bituop',password:'Bituop123'}.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Buy-while-logged-out toast being invisible due to immediate Steam redirect is a minor UX finding, not a regression.
